description: Nanomaterials decomposed. Graphene synthesis + properties + applications, carbon nanotube types + production, MXenes, perovskite solar materials, plasmonic nanoparticles, quantum dot variants, self-assembly, nano-toxicology.

sub_mechanisms.name: graphene_synthesis
sub_mechanisms.why: Each method: trade-off quality vs cost. CVD on copper foil scalable. GO chemistry route.

sub_mechanisms.name: graphene_band_structure
sub_mechanisms.definition: Dirac cones at K points. Massless Dirac fermions. Zero bandgap.
sub_mechanisms.why: Unique electronic. Ballistic transport, high mobility. Bandgap engineering required for digital devices.

sub_mechanisms.name: CNT_chirality_metallic_semi
sub_mechanisms.why: Production gives mix. Sorting + selective growth challenges. Foundation of CNT electronics.

sub_mechanisms.name: CNT_production_arc_CVD
sub_mechanisms.definition: Arc discharge (SWCNT first), HiPCO, CoMoCAT. Catalytic CVD scalable.
sub_mechanisms.why: Production at kg-tonne scale. Quality + chirality control improving. Composite + battery applications.

sub_mechanisms.name: MXenes_2D
sub_mechanisms.definition: Transition metal carbides/nitrides. Ti3C2 most studied. Etched from MAX phases.
sub_mechanisms.why: Conductive 2D family. Energy storage, EMI shielding, water purification. Active research.

sub_mechanisms.name: perovskite_solar
sub_mechanisms.definition: ABX3 structure. MAPbI3 archetype. Solution-processable, tunable bandgap.
sub_mechanisms.why: Solar efficiency: 25%+ in cells, rival Si. Cheap to make. Stability + Pb toxicity issues. Active commercialization.

sub_mechanisms.name: plasmonic_nanoparticles
sub_mechanisms.definition: Au, Ag NPs have localised surface plasmon resonance. Strong light absorption + scattering.
sub_mechanisms.why: Bio-imaging, sensing (SERS), photothermal therapy. Colour from size + shape (Lycurgus cup ancient example).

sub_mechanisms.name: quantum_dot_synthesis
sub_mechanisms.definition: Solution synthesis: precursors + ligands at controlled T. CdSe, InP, perovskite QDs.
sub_mechanisms.why: Size control = colour control. Tunable from UV to NIR. Bawendi, Brus, Ekimov Nobel 2023.

sub_mechanisms.name: nano_self_assembly
sub_mechanisms.definition: Particles organize into ordered structures via interparticle forces.
sub_mechanisms.why: Bottom-up nanostructure formation. Block copolymers, DNA origami, colloidal crystals. Foundation soft matter.

sub_mechanisms.name: DNA_origami
sub_mechanisms.definition: DNA strands folded into shapes via base pairing. Nanometer precision.
sub_mechanisms.why: Rothemund 2006. Self-assembled custom shapes. Drug delivery vehicles, nanofabrication. Research → applications.

sub_mechanisms.name: nano_toxicology
sub_mechanisms.definition: Nanoparticles can enter cells, cross blood-brain barrier. Toxicity size + shape + composition dependent.
sub_mechanisms.why: Safety concern. Asbestos analogy for fibers. Regulatory frameworks emerging. Research ongoing.

sub_mechanisms.name: atomic_layer_deposition
sub_mechanisms.definition: ALD: sequential self-limiting surface reactions. Sub-nm thickness control.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern semiconductor fabrication. High-K dielectrics, conformal coatings. Foundation of modern transistors.

derivation_rules.name: graphene_ballistic_transport
then: graphene has ballistic transport at room T over μm
derivation_rules.why: Massless Dirac fermions, weak phonon coupling. 200,000 cm²/Vs measured. Beyond Si (1400). Research target for high-speed devices.

derivation_rules.name: CNT_chirality_predicts_metallicity
derivation_rules.why: Mathematical from graphene Brillouin zone folding. 1/3 metallic, 2/3 semiconducting. Production must sort.

derivation_rules.name: QD_size_tunes_emission_wavelength
then: emission wavelength scales with size (quantum confinement)
derivation_rules.why: Bandgap = bulk gap + confinement energy ∝ 1/L². CdSe 2 nm = green, 6 nm = red. Foundation of QLED displays.

derivation_rules.name: perovskite_efficient_solar
if: perovskite has direct bandgap + long carrier diffusion length
derivation_rules.why: Defect-tolerant, easy fabrication, tunable composition. 25%+ achieved. Path to cheaper solar. Active commercialisation.

derivation_rules.name: ALD_enables_atomic_precision
derivation_rules.why: Each cycle: one monolayer max. Conformal over complex geometry. Foundation of FinFET + GAA transistors. Modern fab.
